name: hard-coded api key is added
why: an api_key assignment with a long quoted value is a classic hard-coded credential

name: hard-coded password using colon syntax
why: yaml-style colon assignment of a password should be caught the same as an equals sign

name: secret value exactly at the eight character threshold
why: the pattern requires eight or more characters inside the quotes; eight exactly should match

name: secret added after a file rename
why: the secret is in an added line regardless of the file having been renamed

name: secret value just under the eight character threshold
why: seven characters is below the minimum length the pattern requires, so it should not match

name: a secret line is only removed, not added
diff:
--- a/src/Config.java
+++ b/src/Config.java
-api_key = "sk_live_1234567890abcdef"
+// removed the old key
why: removed lines are not scanned; deleting a credential should not itself be flagged as adding one

name: the word secret appears in a comment, not an assignment
diff:
+++ b/src/Notes.java
+// TODO: rotate the secret before launch
why: there is no assignment operator or quoted value, so the pattern should not match

name: an entire file containing a secret is deleted
why: the credential line is removed as part of deleting the file, never added
